releases.author: SirHobby
releases.description:
Mobile fixes and a cap on question generation.

- Scope-folder rows in settings are vertically centered on mobile
- Sliders now show their value beside them (touch has no hover tooltip)
- Code snippets wrap and stay inside the question card
- The review view is top-anchored and scrolls on mobile, so the answer buttons clear the bottom navbar
- New "Questions per update" setting (default 30) caps how many new questions one update writes across all notes, so large folders no longer generate 90+ at once

releases.author: SirHobby
releases.description: First public release of Wetstone: turn your notes into adaptive spaced-repetition quizzes across six question formats (multiple choice, true/false, multiple select, fill in the blank, ordering, and cloze), with questions written by an LLM key you supply. Scheduling is FSRS and fully local.
